        If a bytes lift should write them, register it. If not, run hypercase strip -column parse at the module root, then FIXTURE_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 go test ./... until it changes nothing. The strip removes parse's sections from every archive under the module-root corpus, and the update writes back each one a registry claims, but not one whose cell the update writes nothing for, such as a cell that faults.
    export/prices/transform/louder: Uppercases every file under import/out/evaluate/out/.
        parse: Parses the script, as its parse/ tree says.
